tasks.title: yoctoNEAR to NEAR
tasks.prompt: Write yoctoToNear(yocto, decimals = 2) that converts a yoctoNEAR amount (a decimal string, 1 NEAR = 10^24 yocto) to a NEAR string with exactly `decimals` digits after the point, truncating (never rounding). With decimals = 0 return just the integer part. Use BigInt: Number loses precision.

tasks.title: Validate a NEAR account id
tasks.prompt: Write isValidAccountId(id) returning true only for valid NEAR account ids: length 2 to 64; either a 64-character lowercase hex implicit account, or parts separated by '.', where each part is lowercase letters/digits, optionally joined by single '-' or '_' characters. No leading, trailing, or consecutive separators. Non-strings return false.

tasks.title: NFT supply from NEP-297 logs
tasks.prompt: Write nftSupplyFromLogs(logs) that takes an array of log strings from receipts and returns the net NFT supply change: for each log starting with 'EVENT_JSON:' whose JSON has standard 'nep171', add the number of token_ids in every data entry for event 'nft_mint' and subtract them for 'nft_burn'. Ignore other logs, other standards and events, and malformed JSON (never throw).
